question.problem:
Suppose $X$ and $Y$ are discrete random variables. Let the joint CDF of $X$ and $Y$ be $F(x,y),$ where

$$
F(12,4)=0.6,\,F(9,4)=0.3,\,F(3,4)=0.15,
$$

and the supports of $X$ and $Y$, respectively, are

$$
{S}_{X}=\{3,6,9,12\},\,{S}_{Y}=\{2,4,6,8\}.
$$

Find $P(X\ge 6,Y\le 5).$
question.worked_solution:
Note the following:

- For a given joint PMF $f(x,y),$ we can think of each point where $f(x,y)\ne 0$ as a point mass in the plane, where the "probability mass" at each point equals the probability associated with that point.

- The joint CDF $F(x,y)=P(X\le x,Y\le y)$ is the total "probability mass" that lies in the infinite rectangular region that has its top-right corner at $(x,y)$ and whose sides are parallel to the coordinate axis.

Given the supports of $X$ and $Y,$ the joint support $S$ is a subset of

$$
{S}_{X}\times {S}_{Y}=\{3,6,9,12\}\times \{2,4,6,8\}.
$$

Let's plot the points in ${S}_{X}\times {S}_{Y},$ which contains the joint support, and sketch the region corresponding to the probability we wish to find.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14201862/assets/a782578ef55726c98ed23d89cf3de531ede60fe5db3fa9062c05507c5c2f60af.png)

Notice that this region encompasses the same possible support points as the infinite rectangle with its top-right corner at $(12,4)$ and top-left corner at $(3,4),$ where the top and right boundaries are included, and the left boundary is excluded.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14201862/assets/7ba99957a743b5cf283c2668e81b6c1aeb06730d47fc157aec90fe8bc880ced4.png)

Geometrically, this region can be obtained by taking all points in the infinite rectangle that has its top-right corner at $(12,4)$ (the blue region below) and *subtracting* all points in the infinite rectangle that has its top-right corner at $(3,4)$ (the red region below).

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14201862/assets/3bd652b8d918e26cd330ad43555f039845d0b5405b70c96828bb2d652b7f872c.png)

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\ge 6,Y\le 5) & =\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(12,4)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 12,Y\le 4)}}-\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(3,4)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 3,Y\le 4)}} \\  & =F(12,4)-F(3,4) \\  & =0.6-0.15 \\  & =0.45.\end{aligned}
$$
